svg.title: A duplicate, from the notice to its closing
svg.desc: The reporter opens an issue. The analysis of issue-assistant.yml says that it looks like a duplicate of an older issue and closes in 3 days, and adds possible-duplicate. A comment of anyone in those days removes possible-duplicate at once, and the issue stays open. A thumbs down on the notice by the reporter or by someone who may push makes the morning sweep of issue-lifecycle.yml remove possible-duplicate after the 3 days, and the issue stays open. Without an objection, the morning sweep posts a comment, closes the issue as a duplicate of the original and labels it duplicate.
